exceptions.reason: D-03 (Phase 100b): this route resets a single test-only tenant's full dataset for e2e bootstrapping. The 17 deleteMany calls (lines 242-277) are the teardown: giving every context its own destructive resetForTests() on its PERMANENT public surface would be the worse trade in an audit-proof system, so this direct-access path is excepted instead of facaded. The route is gated behind ALLOW_TEST_BOOTSTRAP, never registers on int or prod, and its teardown only ever matches tenant IDs of the form ^test-[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{8}$, so the exception exists for something that is not reachable in a real environment at all. The 4 create calls (overtimeAccount:173, leaveType:180, leaveEntitlement:188, terminalApiKey:332) are seeding calls for the same test-only bootstrap route and are excepted on the same grounds; terminalApiKey.create at line 332 is a separate seeding block outside the teardown handler proper but serves the identical test-bootstrap purpose. Lines shifted +1 in Phase 101B Plan 05 Task 1 (one eslint-disable-next-line comment inserted above this file's cross-context absence/leave-type import, E-8) — no finding, mechanical only.

Phase 101B (Issue #101): computeOvertimeBalanceBreakdown's hasTodayEntries cutoff check and its worked-minutes-since-snapshot read were moved verbatim, unedited, out of time-tracking/api/time-entries.ts into this file, per the owner's own Nebenbefund decision that the whole overtime-balance closure belongs in working-time-account on domain grounds (101B-ZYKLEN-BEFUND.md §4) — measured cycle-neutral, not measured against this Phase-100b gate. Tracked as a residual driver alongside the ones 101B-ZYKLEN-BEFUND.md §7 already hands to ADR 0001 Eintrag H (Block-2, #102-#104).
